capabilities: Show git blame (author, time, message, hash) at the end of the cursor line
Configure the blame display with {date} {time} {author} {message} {hash} placeholders
Choose relative or absolute timestamp formatting
Mark uncommitted lines and optionally ignore whitespace-only changes (git blame -w)
Show the current line's author in the status bar
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js APIs); requires git on PATH. README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and describes its security approach (execFile, no shell).
problem: Obsidian gives no way to see who last changed the line you are editing when the vault is tracked in Git.
summary: Git blame plugin that shows the current line's committer, commit time, and commit message as an inline annotation at the line end.
